title: Harden tool-span diagnostics against callback failures
description:
Harden turn-loop tool span diagnostics so telemetry callback failures cannot abort gameplay/model execution.

Problem:
The turn loop documents onToolSpan as best-effort telemetry that must never throw, but the callback is invoked from the tool execution path without a local safety wrapper. A diagnostics sink failure should not fail an otherwise successful turn.

Acceptance criteria:
- Wrap onToolSpan invocation in a local try/catch.
- Preserve turn/tool success behavior if telemetry storage/reporting fails.
- Add a focused regression test where onToolSpan throws and the tool/model loop still returns the expected result.
- Optionally surface the telemetry failure through a safe debug path that cannot recursively trigger the same failure.
close_reason: Wrapped tool-span callback emission in the model loop, preserving successful tool/model execution when diagnostics callbacks throw; added regression coverage.
